name: James Talarico

lean.basis: Democratic Texas state representative since 2019; won the 2026 Senate race as a Democrat.

sources.title: Talarico flips Texas Senate seat, ending 38-year Democratic drought — Axios

source.title: File:James Talarico Press Conference (cropped).jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: U.S. senator-elect from Texas (won November 2026); Texas state representative since 2019
summary: James Talarico (born 1989), a former middle-school teacher and Presbyterian seminarian, served in the Texas House from 2019. In November 2026 he beat Ken Paxton to flip a Texas Senate seat, the first Democratic Senate win there since 1988, in the most expensive Senate race in US history, outraising Paxton about $155 million to $40 million while Elon Musk put at least $212 million behind Paxton.
